name: TiltedCard-TS-TW
blurb: Card with image that tilts in 3D space following cursor position.
description: A card containing an image that rotates in 3D based on mouse position. Responds to cursor movement for tilt angles. Shows a caption below the image. Responsive height and width.
use_when: Portfolio galleries, product showcases, or testimonial sections where 3D interactivity enhances visual appeal.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused sites or touch-only platforms — 3D transform doesn't convey information.
a11y: Image has alt text. Caption is text content. Tilt effect is visual only.
